q.t: What number comes just after 39?
q.e: Just after means 1 more: 39 + 1 = 40. The 9 ones become a new ten.

q.t: What number comes just before 70?
q.e: Just before means 1 less: 70 − 1 = 69.

q.t: Find the next number: 1, 4, 7, 10, ___
q.e: Each number is 3 more than the one before: 10 + 3 = 13.

q.t: Skip count in fives: 40, 45, 50, ___
q.e: Counting in fives adds 5 each time: 50 + 5 = 55.

q.t: Skip count in tens: 50, 60, 70, ___
q.e: Counting in tens adds 1 ten each time: 70 + 10 = 80.

q.t: Count back: 10, 9, 8, ___
q.e: Counting back takes away 1 each time: 8 − 1 = 7.

q.t: Count back in tens: 100, 90, 80, ___
q.e: Each step takes away 1 ten: 80 − 10 = 70.

q.t: A frog sits on 12 on a number line and jumps 5 steps forward. Where does it land?
q.e: Forward means adding: 12 + 5 = 17.

q.t: Which number is between 64 and 66?
q.e: 1 more than 64 is 65, and 65 is 1 less than 66.

q.t: A ginladi (bead frame) has 10 rows with 10 beads in each row. How many beads in all?
Count back in threes: 40, 37, 34, ___
q.e: Each step takes away 3: 34 − 3 = 31.

q.t: Count back in fives: 70, 65, 60, ___
q.e: Each step takes away 5: 60 − 5 = 55.

q.t: Count back in twenties: 100, 80, ___
q.e: Each step takes away 20 (2 tens): 80 − 20 = 60.

q.t: On the 1 to 100 number chart, which number is just below 28?
q.e: Each row of the chart has 10 numbers, so one row down is 10 more.

q.t: On the 1 to 100 number chart, which number is just above 53?
q.e: One row up is 10 less: 53 − 10 = 43.

q.t: On the 1 to 100 number chart, which number is just to the left of 26?
q.e: Moving one box left is 1 less.

q.t: A squirrel is on 10. It jumps 2 steps back, then 5 steps forward, then 3 steps back. Where is it now?
q.e: 10 − 2 = 8, 8 + 5 = 13, 13 − 3 = 10. It went back 5 and forward 5, so it ends where it began.

q.t: Start at 0 and count in fives. Will you say 55?
q.e: Counting in fives from 0 says only numbers ending in 0 or 5, and 55 ends in 5.

q.t: Start at 4 and count in twos. Will you say 17?
q.e: 4, 6, 8, 10 … all end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. 17 ends in 7, so you jump over it.

q.t: Which numbers come just before 10, 20, 30 and 40?
q.e: Just before means 1 less, so each one ends in 9.

q.t: Chavi counts in twos from 10: 10, 12, 14 … Will she say 43?
q.e: Starting at 10 and adding 2, the ones digit is always 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. 43 ends in 3.

q.t: Mala counts back in ones from 20 to 0. How many steps does she take?
q.e: Each step takes away 1, and she must take away all 20.

q.t: Viraaj counts back in twos from 20 to 0. How many steps does he take?
q.e: 20, 18, 16 … 2, 0: each step takes away 2, and 10 twos make 20.

q.t: Rizwan counts from 20 onwards: 20, 21, 22 … Will he say 19?
q.e: 19 comes before 20, and he only counts forward from 20.

q.t: On the number chart: 1, 12, 23, 34, ___ (each time one row down and one box right).
q.e: One row down adds 10 and one box right adds 1, so each step adds 11.

q.t: From 1 to 20, which numbers are said in BOTH the count in twos and the count in fives?
q.e: Twos: 2, 4 … 20. Fives: 5, 10, 15, 20. Only 10 and 20 are in both.

q.t: Start at 13 and count in threes. Will you land on 24?
q.e: 13, 16, 19, 22, 25 … you jump from 22 straight to 25, so you miss 24.

q.t: Blocks pattern: 1, 3, 6, 10, ___
q.e: The jumps grow: add 2, then 3, then 4, so next add 5.

q.t: Blocks pattern: 1, 4, 9, ___
q.e: The jumps are 3, then 5, so next is 7: 9 + 7 = 16.

q.t: An ant sits on a number line exactly halfway between 20 and 80. Which number is it on?
q.e: From 20 to 80 is 6 tens; halfway is 3 tens along: 20 + 30 = 50.

q.t: You throw two dice and add the dots. What is the biggest total you can get?
q.e: Each dice shows at most 6 dots, so the most is 6 + 6 = 12.

q.t: You throw two dice and add the dots. What is the smallest total you can get?
q.e: Each dice shows at least 1 dot, so the least is 1 + 1 = 2.

q.t: Count in fives and count in sevens from 0. Which is the first number (more than 0) said in both counts?
q.e: Fives: 5, 10 … 35. Sevens: 7, 14, 21, 28, 35. They first meet at 35.

q.t: Who am I? I am more than 40 and less than 50, and both my digits are the same.
q.e: Numbers in the forties have 4 tens, so the ones digit must also be 4.

q.t: Start at 47. Go 10 more, then 1 less. Where are you?
q.e: 47 + 10 = 57 (one more ten), then 57 − 1 = 56.

q.t: On the number chart, start at 74. Go one row down and one box right. Which number?
q.e: One row down is 10 more (84), one box right is 1 more (85).

q.t: Start at 5 and count in fives. Will you land on 40?
q.e: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40 — numbers ending in 0 or 5 are all said.

q.t: Find the missing number: 100, 90, 80, ___, 60
q.e: The numbers go down by 10 each time: 80 − 10 = 70.

q.t: Find the missing number: 3, 6, 9, ___, 15
q.e: The numbers go up by 3 each time: 9 + 3 = 12, and 12 + 3 = 15 checks it.

q.t: A frog is on 25. It jumps 2 steps forward, then 7 steps back, then 3 steps back. Where is it now?
